tagline: A real estate investment trust focused on grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties in the Washington, DC/Baltimore metropolitan area.
hero_kpi_rationale: Occupancy rate is a key performance indicator for commercial REITs, reflecting leasing demand and asset quality. It acts as a structural driver of revenue stability.

kpis.name: Occupancy rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space currently rented in shopping centers.
kpis.description: Comparable occupancy rate declined from 95.2% at end-2024 to 94.6% at end-2025, indicating slight deterioration or tenant turnover.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in occupancy, signaling leasing pressure or tenant transition.

kpis.name: Base rent
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue from fixed rental payments made by tenants.
kpis.description: Base rent increased by 9.6% between 2024 and 2025, rising from $216.6M to $237.4M, reflecting strong lease renewal dynamics.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in rental income, driven by expansion and renovation.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: Net profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income decreased from $67.7M in 2024 to $49.2M in 2025, primarily due to initial operating losses on Twinbrook Quarter Phase I ($14.3M) and Hampden House ($5.1M).
kpis.signal: Significant decline due to initial losses on new projects.

kpis.name: Debt to total asset value ratio
kpis.explanation: Proportion of debt relative to total asset value.
kpis.description: Debt to total asset value ratio remains below 50%, allowing the company access to new financing if needed.
kpis.signal: Controlled leverage level, supporting financial flexibility.

kpis.name: Fixed-rate debt proportion
kpis.explanation: Share of total debt with fixed interest rates.
kpis.description: 88.4% of debt is fixed-rate with maturities staggered from 2026 to 2041, reducing interest rate and refinancing risk.
kpis.signal: Limited refinancing risk exposure due to predominantly fixed-rate debt.

kpis.name: Unhedged variable-rate debt
kpis.explanation: Amount of debt exposed to interest rate fluctuations without hedging.
kpis.description: Unhedged variable-rate debt amounts to $189.0M, drawn from the New Credit Facility, with $96.2M remaining availability.
kpis.signal: Moderate exposure to variable rates, managed through credit facility.

risks.title: Real estate market decline
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to real estate market fluctuations, particularly in the Washington, DC/Baltimore region.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with numerous players present in the region.

risks.title: Credit and refinancing risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant unhedged variable-rate debt of $189M, which could increase its credit risk in case of rising interest rates or market decline.

risks.title: Government regulations
risks.score_rationale: Actions by the federal government could impact the real estate market and the company's operations in the Washington, DC/Baltimore region.

risks.title: Operating losses on new projects
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded significant operating losses in 2025 ($14.3M for Twinbrook Quarter Phase I and $5.1M for Hampden House), which could affect its ability to sustain investment levels.

risks.title: Asset quality deterioration
risks.score_rationale: The company has assets that could deteriorate in quality, particularly with the occupancy rate decline from 95.2% to 94.6%, which could affect their value and revenue.

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation risks, particularly regarding real estate laws and regulations.
